test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the following sentence the underlined part contains an error. Alternatives to the underlined part are given as options. Choose the correct alternative.

She is __late__ than we expected.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. later .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"late"** refers to time, and its comparative form is **"later."**
 
• The sentence is comparing the expected time with the actual time of arrival, so the correct word to use is the comparative form **"later."**
 
• Other options like **"latter"** refer to the second of two items, **"more late"** is incorrect usage, and **"latest"** refers to the superlative form, which is not relevant in this context.

Correct sentence: *She is later than we expected.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Usage of Comparative and Superlative Forms:**

 
 
• **Comparative:** Used to compare two items (e.g., later, bigger, smaller).
 
• **Superlative:** Used to describe the highest degree of a quality (e.g., latest, biggest, smallest).
 
 
 
• **Examples:**
 
 
• **Comparative:** She arrived later than expected.
 
• **Superlative:** This is the latest model of the car.
